findings.text: follow-on: containment.evidence.scratch_ledger_rows reads 16, but the runner does not measure that number on the scratch graph — it assigns the ledger call count (scratch_ledger_rows=calls at ssog-anchor-ab-run.py:612 and :621), so the reported scratch_signal of 32 at line 29 counts 16 rows true by construction and 16 measured at scratch_family_rows (line 22). The containment verdict is not falsified: the load-bearing negative arm (live_family_rows 0, live_scope_run_rows 0) is independently measured, and the positive arm also has the measured scratch_family_rows, so this is a reader hazard rather than a wrong verdict. It does not hold the node because the construction lives in the unchanged per-arm runner (owned by the ssog-anchor-family-runner node), not in this node's diff.

item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when (brief.md:41-49 and the dispatch FENCE at prompt.txt:253) requires the receipt to carry outcome_status complete, the anchor, lint before and after, every member's documentation score after, calls, spend, wall time, stamped, the containment verdict with its evidence and the code digest, written by a detached invocation whose log ends EXIT=0, with the scratch instance stopped and its tree removed and spend under USD 2.00; all of these are present (lint 3 to 2, scores 0.849/1.0/0.9375, 16 calls, USD 0.481093, 1015.4 s, stamped false, containment holds true, code.tree_digest_imas_codex set) and the spend is below the cap.
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is to run the Jev arm of length_of_passive_loop_element in a scratch graph through the per-arm runner; docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab/length_of_passive_loop_element-jev.json is that arm's receipt and the runner invocation's log ends EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read the reviewed node's manifest.md: status complete, tests names the per-arm runner command, test_logs name runner-jev-retry.log (ends EXIT=0) and containment-guard.log (ends EXIT=0), measurement_module and measurement_cwd are recorded, baseline_suite and after_suite are empty because the gate is a measurement run and not a pytest suite, and retry_failures names the read-only-/tmp scaffolding failure.
item_verdicts.write_paths: The dispatch FENCE — SCOPE at prompt.txt:218-221 fences three paths: the receipt, docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-passive-loop-jev-r2.html and the figures directory; the diff adds the first two and nothing else, and the brief's narrower '## Write scope' single-path list is superseded by the dispatch fence.

justifications.durability: The diff adds no assertion at all (two data files), so nothing reddens if the receipt regresses; the node's declared control (containment-guard.log) re-exercises the runner's containment check with three planted refusals, and its scratch-only positive case seeds scratch_family_rows and scratch_ledger_rows from the receipt's own calls at ssog-anchor-ab-run.py:229-230, so it is not independent of the value it is meant to observe.
justifications.evidence: Every receipt field reconciles with the apply log (docs/evidence/.../apply-jev-length_of_passive_loop_element.log EXIT=0, cost_spent 0.481093, the same harmonize receipt) and with runner-jev-retry.log's EXIT=0 summary, and per_model spend sums exactly to spend_usd.
justifications.fit: The two artifacts follow the established evidence-fragment convention of docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-camera-width-heuristic.html, and both commit messages carry a conventional subject plus a body with no plan label, version suffix or AI attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab/length_of_passive_loop_element-jev.json is the arm the goal names, complete per its done_when, though the family harmonization halted with zero members accepted so the arm is a partial comparison input.
justifications.reuse: The diff adds no function, class or module to extend or duplicate an owner; the per-arm runner docs/evidence/fragments/sn-selection-over-generation/ssog-anchor-ab-run.py is reused byte-identical between base and head (git diff 5cf53a7b6 HEAD -- that path is empty).
justifications.scope_discipline: Both added paths sit inside the three-path dispatch fence at prompt.txt:218-221 and the diff touches no module, runner, test or generated file.
